name: 40962 · Manchester, KY
findings: ZIP 40962 (Manchester) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 5 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40962 (Manchester) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 40962 (Manchester) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 43% of the typical level).
